nodes.description: External view interface function returning true if the given fact was previously registered.
Internal view interface that verifies a Merkle decommitment for n leaves and returns the resulting hash.
External view interface returning true if at least one fact has been registered.
Internal pure function returning the default hash mask 0xFFFFFFFF...000000000000000000000000.
Verifies a Merkle tree decommitment for n leaves using inline assembly over channel and queue pointers, then requires hash == root.
External view wrapper that delegates fact checking to _factCheck.
Internal view function reading the verifiedFact mapping for a given fact.
Internal function storing a fact hash in verifiedFact and setting anyFactRegistered on first registration.
External view function returning the anyFactRegistered flag.
Public entry point that validates merkle queue indices with inline assembly, calls verify, and registers the keccak256 fact hash.
Constant limiting the number of merkle verifier queries to 128.
Private mapping from fact hash to verification status.
Boolean flag indicating whether at least one fact has been registered.
Inline assembly that performs raw memory reads/writes and keccak256 hashing with unchecked pointer arithmetic to build the merkle root.
Inline assembly that copies the initial merkle queue, validates the index range, rewrites the free memory pointer at 0x40 and hashes the queue.
nQueries is computed as initialMerkleQueue.length / 2 without checking that the queue length is even, silently dropping a trailing element on odd input.
